title: Your connection config
name: Name

key.title: Key for the AmneziaVPN app
key.label: vpn:// key
key.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically: the key is selected, copy it by hand.

downloadHint: The .conf file is for the AmneziaWG app and routers.

qr.title: Another device
qr.hint: In AmneziaVPN tap “+” → “QR code” and point the camera at this screen: the app collects the codes by itself.

android.steps: Install AmneziaVPN from Google Play or from amnezia.org. Open the app, tap “+” and paste the vpn:// key or scan the QR code from another screen. Then tap “Connect”.

ios.steps: Install AmneziaVPN from the App Store. Open the app, tap “+” and paste the copied vpn:// key, or scan the QR code from another screen. Then tap “Connect”.

windows.steps: Install AmneziaVPN from amnezia.org. In the app tap “+” and paste the vpn:// key, or open the .conf file. Then tap “Connect”.

macos.steps: Install AmneziaVPN from the App Store or from amnezia.org. In the app tap “+” and paste the vpn:// key, or open the .conf file. Then tap “Connect”.

warning: This is your personal key. Do not forward or publish the link. If someone else may have seen it, message the bot /config: the old link stops opening and the bot sends a new one.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.hint: It may have expired or been replaced. Message the bot /config and it will send a new link.

tooMany.title: Too many attempts
tooMany.hint: Wait a few minutes and open the link again.

network.title: No connection to the server
network.hint: Check your internet and reload the page.

failed.title: The page did not open
failed.hint: Reload the page in a little while. If that does not help, message the bot /config.

hidden.title: The config was removed from the screen
hidden.hint: To open it again, open the link from the bot. If you lost the link, message the bot /config.
